day.name: Private Borobudur Climb & Prambanan Day
day.benefit: Combine the Borobudur climb and Prambanan with a private vehicle and Yogyakarta hotel pickup.
day.facts: About 8 hours. English driver/guide; temple admission and the Borobudur climb included. Lunch and a local Prambanan guide cost extra. Mendut monastery substitutes for the temple during renovation.
day.restriction: Choose the full-day option (TG1). Monday has a separate option with different Prambanan access. Confirm the exact itinerary for your date.
day.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

half.name: Borobudur-Only Private Half Day
half.benefit: Keep the trip to one monument, with a guided climb and private return transport from Yogyakarta.
half.facts: About 5 hours including travel. English guidance, Borobudur climb admission and Yogyakarta hotel pickup. Meals excluded.
half.restriction: Select “Borobudur Only Half Day Tour” (TG4) on the listing; its headline also advertises the longer combined tour.
half.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

vip.name: VIP Sunrise On The Temple & Prambanan
vip.benefit: Watch dawn from Borobudur itself, then continue to Prambanan with private hotel transport.
vip.facts: About 8 hours. Separate VIP sunrise option, temple admission and English driver/guide. Lunch and a local Prambanan guide excluded.
vip.restriction: Select “VIP SUNRISE ON THE TOP TEMPLE” (TG3). Order at least two days ahead and contact the operator about availability before booking. Hill sunrise is a different experience.
vip.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

merapi.name: Setumbu Sunrise, Merapi Jeep & Two Temples
merapi.benefit: Pair Setumbu hill dawn with a Merapi jeep route and the Borobudur and Prambanan visits.
merapi.facts: About 12 hours, private Yogyakarta pickup, English driver/guide, jeep rental and program admission. Meals and a local Prambanan guide extra.
merapi.restriction: Choose the hill-sunrise option (TG2). This is a long, uneven jeep day, not a volcano summit hike. Monday has a different option. Published age bands have gaps; confirm all participants.
merapi.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

food.name: Yogyakarta Night Food Walk
food.benefit: Taste Javanese street food with a local English-speaking guide and a becak ride.
food.facts: 3–4 hours; food, drinks and becak included. Small group, maximum 8. Meet in central Yogyakarta; hotel transport excluded.
food.restriction: Confirm dietary needs with the operator. The menu varies; no specific dish is guaranteed.
food.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

heritage.name: Yogyakarta Heritage & Batik Workshop
heritage.benefit: Explore the Keraton, a traditional market and a museum, then try a hands-on batik workshop.
heritage.facts: About 6.5 hours, English guide, one-way pedicab and water. Entrance fees are extra. Confirm the meeting arrangement with the operator.
heritage.restriction: The itinerary includes walking. Palace access and local opening arrangements must be confirmed for your date.
heritage.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

batik.name: Three-Hour Batik Master Class
batik.benefit: Work through the batik process with an English-speaking trainer and take your creation home.
batik.facts: About 3 hours. Materials, finished batik, refreshments and local food included. Meet near Sojiwan, south of Prambanan; transport not included.
batik.restriction: Get the exact workshop address from the operator. Published ages omit 13–16; confirm eligibility instead of assuming.
batik.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

angkor.name: Angkor Sunrise Or Sunset From Siem Reap
angkor.benefit: Explore Angkor with an English-speaking guide and air-conditioned transport from Siem Reap.
angkor.facts: About 8 hours. Hotel pickup, guide, water and towels; Angkor pass and meals excluded. Sunrise/sunset and private/small-group options.
angkor.restriction: Choose the timing and group type on Viator. This is a Cambodia outing, with no transport from Java.
angkor.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

komodo.name: Komodo Islands By Speedboat
komodo.benefit: Spend a day among Komodo, Padar and snorkeling stops from Labuan Bajo.
komodo.facts: About 11 hours. Speedboat, snorkeling equipment, snacks and water. Limited mainland hotel pickup; national park fees extra.
komodo.restriction: Arrange your own travel to Labuan Bajo. Weather can change stops; wildlife sightings are not guaranteed. Check boat, hiking and health restrictions.
komodo.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

gyg.name: Borobudur Climb & Prambanan Options
gyg.benefit: Compare the Setumbu hill-sunrise and climb options with transport from Yogyakarta.
gyg.facts: 5–12 hours depending on option. English guide/driver and Yogyakarta pickup. Temple tickets are included only with the all-inclusive option; lunch extra.
gyg.restriction: Select the actual sunrise, group type and ticket bundle you want. Setumbu is a hill outside the temple; confirm Monday access for your date.
gyg.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

gygangkor.name: Angkor One- Or Two-Day Sunrise Tour
gygangkor.benefit: Compare a focused Angkor sunrise day with a wider two-day guided temple itinerary.
gygangkor.facts: English guide, hotel pickup, small group up to 15. Angkor pass and meals extra.
gygangkor.restriction: Minimum age 8; not suitable for wheelchair users. An eight-hour time match applies only to the one-day option. Select one or two days; travel from Java is separate.
gygangkor.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

gili.name: Gili Islands Snorkeling From Lombok
gili.benefit: Visit the three Gili islands by shared glass-bottom boat with snorkeling equipment supplied.
gili.facts: About 8.5 hours, English guide. Senggigi hotel pickup only if selected. Lunch and pickup outside the included area cost extra.
gili.restriction: Not suitable for mobility impairments. Confirm swimming and participant requirements; turtle sightings are not guaranteed.
gili.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified

jungle.name: Bukit Lawang Jungle & Orangutan Trek
jungle.benefit: Explore the Bukit Lawang forest on a guided outing with a three-hour jungle hike.
jungle.facts: One-day outing; park entry, meals and guide listed. Confirm the transport pickup point before booking.
jungle.restriction: Wildlife sightings are not guaranteed. Maximum published age 80 and weight 150 kg. This is in North Sumatra, not a day trip from Bali or Java.
jungle.mobility: Unassisted walking and stairs; accessible route not verified
